protocol.purpose: Replace the failed cold pure-state inverse search with a feasible fixed-N singlet ensemble and physical response spaces
protocol.input: Saved ensemble input densities from prior potential paths; all are development/oracle-density diagnostics
protocol.initialization: Full canonical paired-determinant lift of the input density, T+W responses and density response directions; no molecular h, nuclear potential or labels
protocol.failure_policy: Retain the last feasible positive fixed-N ensemble and its upper energy estimate; return no XC potential unless all stationarity checks pass
protocol.assessment: Access the saved universal energy only after each prediction stops; no error-target stopping or setting changes
limits: Dense reduced ensemble with matrix-free full actions
Not a general learned or many-block model
No nuclear-force derivative, broad WTMAD-2 or timing claim
